THE SHARPENING: under W ALONE there are 25 orbits and eight of nine rows split -- only A3 (2160) is already a single W-orbit; D5's 108 is 4 x 27, A4's 1728 is 4 x 432, A5's 144 is 2 x 72, and so on. CONSEQUENCE, and it is the load-bearing one: a single orbit forces a UNIQUE invariant measure while a union of k orbits admits a (k-1)-parameter family, so the 'only object-consistent measure is uniform' step is forced by W x GALOIS-invariance and NOT by W-invariance -- the measure argument needs the ARITHMETIC symmetry as a stated hypothesis. Also explains a number: the external proposal's 108 = 27x4, offered as an observation, is literally four Galois-conjugate W-orbits of size 27. SCOPE: the W-action on the 5-torsion of the E6 torus; nothing about the manifold, and nothing about whether the Z/5 menu is this object's -- B8086 showed it is NOT (H_1 = Z, torsion-free). ## How to falsify any of this

1. Every closure names an **escape hatch** -- the computation that would reopen it. Pick a
   door in `CLOSED_DOORS.md`, run its hatch; the door holds or it does not.
2. Every PROVED arc names its **test locks**. Run them.
3. The gates (`python3 scripts/gates/gates.py`) enforce the governance invariants, and each
   was verified by deliberate breakage -- a gate never observed to fail is not a gate.

You do not need to read the record to check the programme. That is the point of this page.
